ATOMIC MONOCHROME ARTWORK — 3 NOVEMBER 2026

Use these black/white SVGs for monochrome applications. Four distinct shapes
and transparent gaps preserve the overlapping symbol, following the supplied
reference. White gaps in the black reference represent transparency, not a
white background painted into the logo. The white version uses identical
geometry and works on purple, black, photographs and other backgrounds.

The lowercase lettering remains the approved Inter SemiBold 600 outlines.
Do not flatten the gradient symbol into one solid silhouette or simulate the
monochrome symbol with a brightness/invert filter. The gradient identity and
its dark-background version remain separate from these monochrome variants.

Geometry is derived from the original 226/96 ellipse proportions and -20°
rotation, with a 12-unit overlap separation in the 512-unit symbol viewBox.
Curves are encoded as dense vector paths (2048 samples per ellipse); no image,
background rectangle, font dependency, filter, mask or clipping is required.
